turns.text: So, kahit na wala kayong mahanap na ebidensya ng money laundering, pero... Mapatunayan yung requirements ng unexplained wealth sa ilalim ng Republic Act 3019 Section 8 ay pwede pa rin po magka-finding ng unexplained wealth. So tama po yung sinabi ko. Even if there is no case or finding of money laundering, a case for unexplained wealth can still prosper If the evidence is there to prove unexplained well.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Ngayon,

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: nakausap niyo si Defense Counsel bago po kayo na upo dito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Unfortunately, hindi po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So, hindi po niya naipaliwanag sa inyo kung ano talaga yung nasa loob ng Article 2 ng Articles of Impeachment?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: At hindi nyo rin nabasa bago ngayon yung laman.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Sa balita po, nabasa po yung laman ng article.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I'm sorry, hindi ko.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Sa balita po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ah, sa balita. Pero yung mismong dokumento na Article 2, you have not read?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Not.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Now, that may perhaps be the difficulty in your testimony. Kasi po, ang batayan ng Article 2, kung babasahin po ninyo yung laman, Ay hindi naman po Republic Act 9160.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Sorry to interrupt.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I have no question yet.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: I understand that. But Your Honor, Good Counsel already used the terms difficulty. So in other words, again, Your Honor, with all due respect, it's not the prosecution's function to interpret the... or give probative value to the testimony of the witness. It is the function of the court. He can just ask questions, Your Honor, to test his credibility.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I haven't heard a question yet, Attorney Mark. Kindly restate your question, Honorable Chell. I don't believe you've asked a question yet.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Not yet, Your Honor. Since you did not get to read Article 2 of the Articles of Impeachment, you do not know that This article is based on Republic Act 3019.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Based on the news, Your Honor, and the research that I did before coming in here, yes, I know that it's based on that Republic Act.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So you confirm that this article on unexplained wealth is based, one of the laws is Republic Act 3019, anti-graphic corrupt practices law. You confirm that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: You confirm as well that Law is in relation to the provisions of Republic Act 1379 on civil forfeiture.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: You also confirm that Article 2 is based on Republic Act 6713, your code of conduct of public officials and employees.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: And most especially, you confirm that the allegations of unexplained wealth, amassing of wealth manifestly disproportional to the lawful income of the respondent, the allegations of participation in business that is prohibited by law, as well as the non-declaration of salary. These are all based on the Constitution of our country.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. No

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: more questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Redirect, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Redirect, Attorney Mark.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Good afternoon. Kunti na lang po, Attorney De La Fuente. During cross-examination, you were questioned about your limited time with the AMLC or particularly the AMLC Secretariat. However, you also characterized your stint with the AMLC as brief and meaningful. Can you explain that? Bakit yung po nasabi yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yung aking competence and experience, it's not counted by the quantity of years that I have been with the Secretariat. So it's not on the quantity but the quality of work. Kung mahaba nga akong oras ninyo, pero for lack of better term, pabanjing-banjing ka lang, wala rin yung, it's not meaningful experience. Now, when I left the Council na Secretariat noong 2018, if hindi maganda ang aking record, probably they won't accredit me 2019. Other than that, I also got another accreditation from PAGCOR. Again, if hindi naging maganda ang aking record, ang aking trabaho, I won't be able to get those approvals.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Art, you mentioned yung accreditation na yun from AMLA. This is already beyond your stint sa AMLC?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. That's 2019, a year after I left the service.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Correct. But yet, you described... Another function which is an accredited trainer of the AMLC. Paano po ba ito? Can you describe your functions kahit nawala na po kayo sa AMLC?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, napaka-importante kasi, no, that we make the public, especially the covered persons, aware of their obligations, no, AML obligations. Sa dami ho ng ating covered persons, hindi ho yan na-accommodate lahat ng ating AMLC Secretariat. So they accredit private

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Individuals and also institutional training providers. They subject to vetting process. Ini-screen ho yan. Do you have the proper experience, competence? So meron din hong tine-check. Nagkaroon ng demo lectures. If we follow the syllabus of the AMLC. So hindi ho siya basta-basta pinoprovide. Meron hong proseso bago kabigyan ng accreditation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Thank you for that clarification. So, in terms of training of or training with AMLC people, how would you characterize your work kahit na wala na po kayo sa AMLC?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I still do maintain good relationship with them. But again, hiwalay ko ang personal sa professional.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright. And then you also mentioned that you have extensive...

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Experience in financial investigation despite your limited time with the AMLC. Paano niyo po nasabi na extensive yung naging experience niyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Lahat ho ng klase ng trabaho ng isang financial investigator na daanan na ho. In fact, that's the reason why I left the service.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Natatakot na ho ang aking pamilya dahil sa risk. So, when I reached that point, I think I already contributed enough. For the service, that's the time for me to think about my family and also my personal career. That's why I left the service and also tried to establish my own law office.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Thank you po for that clarification. On cross, you also mentioned about yung Section 8A ng AMLA. And again, we don't have any question with the authority of this court. In fact, yung questions po on direct. Really pertained on the proceedings or processes before the House Committee on Justice. If you can just distinguish po ba, paano po ba naiiba yung proceedings ng impeachment court na ito sa ibang mga proceedings na hindi naman po court?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, normally, when we go to the financial investigation part, marami po munang pinagdadaanan yan. Council approval, and then you file a petition with the Court of Appeals for freeze order. and Bank Inquiry. So marami kong pinagdadaan ng proseso yan. Dito sa ating impeachment court, again, the court is free to adopt its own rules and request subpoenaed documents from agencies such as AMLOC po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright, thank you po. Now, you also mentioned that subpoenaed documents, no? I understand that may mga subpoenaed documents yung court. But again, just to clarify, what is the propriety of disclosing even subpoenaed documents to a third party? If you can just answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, that would contravene the second paragraph. It is authorized disclosure but re-disseminating, re-forwarding that information without observing the proper guidelines is I think a violation. Section 8-A.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Okay. Na-mention din po yung maraming question on cross yung kay Atty. Cabrera. Yung disclosure po kay Atty. Cabrera, what is the propriety of that without the proper court order? If you just can answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, sorry. I have no personal knowledge as to how it was submitted to him, how it was shared to him. Ako po ay nakabase lang sa batas. At plainly, nasa ating Section 2, Section 8-A, na dapat ho may sinunod na proper protocols.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Thank you po. You were also asked about piercing the corporate veil. Sinabi nyo on direct na it is the court that has the authority to do that pero on cross sinabi nyo naman din na if I can recall that wala namang problema kung gawin nyo ng forensic act. How do you reconcile those two concepts?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, sorry.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Kasi sinabi niyo po on direct na it is the court that has the authority to pierce. Pero on cross, tinatanong kayo si Atty. Cabrera kasi nag-pierce din siya ng corporate. So how do you reconcile po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, the so-called piercing made by the forensic is only for analysis. It's not, again, dalabaho ang... Financial intelligence, which is analytical, at saka financial investigation. In my own humble opinion, what he did is, on the first part, analytical. It's not yet evidence gathering that would trigger yung mga compulsive or coercive processes. So, in that case, that is only for case build-up. Fact-finding lang ho yun. Hindi pa siya ebidensya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: You were also confronted with the fact that you did not access yung mga actual CTRs and STRs para hindi niyo po, and you said na hindi niyo po mako-confront yung report ni Atty. Cabrera on this. Ano nga po ulit yung reason why you did not access these reports?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, the only reason, Your Honor, is that, well, that's confidential. I do what I preach. If I'm saying that this is confidential, I also observe that. Even if maganda sana makita ko, but I am not the intended end user of the documents. So why would I bother looking into those documents?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Thank you po. You were also confronted about the idea, yung money laundering versus yung unlawful activity case. Can you just explain to us ano nga po ba yung pagkakaiba nito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Money laundering is a derivative offense. It has to depend on the prior unlawful activity. Hindi nakadepende ang pagpapafile ng unlawful activity kung mayroong money laundering. Baliktad, dapat nakadepende ang money laundering sa existence ng unlawful activity.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: And yung unlawful activity na po yun, yun po yung source?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Sino po yung may responsibility to prove that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: In our current proceedings, it is the Honorable Impeachment Court who will be determining if there is an unlawful activity or not.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Okay. Based on the allegations?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Based on the allegations.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: And sino po ba yung may responsibility to gather or collate the necessary evidence to prove that unlawful activity? Kung meron pong mga...

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Allegations on money laundering.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Your Honor, please. This line of questioning is very misleading. The presiding officer himself has stated categorically that the respondent is not being charged with money laundering and yet the defense counsel is making it appear that it is the impeachment court that will make a decision about unlawful activities. Wala po sa issue dito pa yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: If he knows, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For the information of the witness, it is not part of the charges against the Vice President, given your admission that you have not yet read the actual articles of impeachment. It is not. With that in mind, kindly answer the question of Attorney Mark.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Can you repeat the question?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Because you were, you were explaining the logical sequence between a Logical sequence involving predicate crime or unlawful activity and money laundering. My question is very simple. Who has the burden of gathering evidence for unlawful activity or predicate crime to support any money laundering?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: In this case, the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: If your honor, please, I move to strike the answer of the witness considering that the presiding officer himself already informed this witness that money laundering is not...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It is not one of the charges, Atty. Raynor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Asked and answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It's not up for the prosecution, Atty. Raynor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the knowledge that it's not part of the articles of impeachment that the Vice President is supposed to answer to or respond to, that's your answer? It's up for the prosecution?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I think the question is who has the burden of proving the unlawful activity?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. In that sequence, only based on that scenario that there is an unlawful activity or predicate crime and then there's a money laundering aspect as well.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I would object then, Your Honor. The question is irrelevant in the material since the respondent is not being charged with any money laundering offense.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: No, I'll allow it because it presupposes a predicate crime, which the counsel for the prosecutors also asked. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly answer, Attorney Reg. Who has the burden of proving? What was your question, Attorney Mark?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Who has the burden of proving that particular aspect on unlawful activity? The unlawful activity. The predicate crime, yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: The prosecution, your honor. Yes. Burden of proving the existence of the unlawful activity.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: And again, just for clarity, what is the burden of proof in these types of accusations or allegations?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, in impeachment. Or normally, if the normal case is, Your Honor, well, I'll prove beyond reasonable doubt. This is a criminal case.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: That will be all, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Rick Ross, Honorable Chell.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: With the permission of the...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Don't you think that your statement about the quality of your work is self-serving?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Well...

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I know myself, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Question is argumentative, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It is argumentative, Honorable Chad.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I will move on. In other words, Mr. Witness, your own evaluation of your work, you have concluded that you have high quality work. That's why you said your stint in the AMLC has been brief and meaningful.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Same objection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It was phrased properly, Counsel. Witness, may answer?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I did not mention the... Word high quality. I just mentioned quality. So it's based on perception. So I see myself, well, during my time, I think the cases that I handled, they showcased it when we had meetings with law enforcement agencies. Yung mga kasong hinawakan ko, yun yung mga pinapakita namin with our counterparts to show how it is done. So that recognition from my superiors, I think, is... An affirmation of the quality of work that I did.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I'll go back to that in a minute. I just have one other question, sir. Yung nabanggit niyo ang burden of proof, proof beyond reasonable doubt, applicable lang po yan sa mga criminal cases, hindi po ba? Yes, po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. That's the, yun po yung nilatagganin ang question sa akin. Kaya I also, that's the normal burden of proof po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Going back to your statement of having a brief but meaningful stint at AMLA and that you have quality work, tama po ba ako na nung kayo ay naging financial investigator sa AMLA, meron din ibang posisyon na financial analyst? Tama po ba yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes po, iba pong grupo yan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So ang trabaho ng financial investigator ay mag-investiga ng money laundering cases.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ano po ang trabaho ng financial analyst?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ang financial analyst po, they receive, they analyze, and disseminate financial intelligence. So magkaiba po ang intelligence sa investigation.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So tama po ba ang statement na it is the financial analyst who examine and analyze CTRs and STRs, covered transactions and suspicious transactions, not the... Financial Investigator.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: No more questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Honorable Chel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Just a short manifestation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, what is the manifestation of Atty. Vinluan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Considering, Your Honor, that there have been a lengthy debate on the credentials also, we just want to express, Your Honor, our gratitude to the witness for attending and for taking the time off from his family and just testifying today. That will be all.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Of course, but you're not yet done, Attorney Rainer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We still have some interjections from Senator Judges. Senator Judge Raffy Tulfo is recognized. First interjection. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready. Thereafter, Senator Judge Erwin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For the record, they're exchanging positions. Senator Judge Pangilinan, first. After Senator Judge Raffy. Senator Judge Raffy, you may proceed, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Expert Witness, the way you are being painted by the defense like you're omniscient. Omniscient, like Omni-witness, like you know everything. Sobrang bilib sila sa'yo, which ako naman may bilib din sa'yo kasi magaling ka na sumagot agad-agad. Tanong ko lang, ano po yung plantilya nyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Bank Officer 2 position po nung akwita sa AMLA.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Correct. Hindi pa entry-level position niya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Good. At meron pa ng Bank Officer 3, Attorney 3, Attorney 4. And yet hindi ka na-promote?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sa 3 or 4?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes po. For that brief statement.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Why were you not promoted? Ba't hindi ka na-promote?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I leave it to the discretion po of my superiors, but if I may continue, Your Honor, before leaving, I was offered a higher position. Now, out of delicadesa, I don't want to make it look like I am bargaining for that position. So I still stick with my decision to leave the service. So, yun po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Actually, after ng bank officer 2, nalipat ka sa office of the executive director, ata, as training staff.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ako po ay... Hineram, kasi may... Pero hindi

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: promotion yun, tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi po, hindi po siya promotion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So, inoperang ka ng promotion, pero tinanggihan mo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Nung ako ay palis na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Pero tinanggap mo yung last training staff?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kasi po, I have to follow kung ano po ang discretion ng aming executive director.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yeah, so anyway, entry-level position yung plantilya mo when you were sa AMLAC. Now, kanina natanong ko sa'yo kung meron ka na natapos na kaso.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sa AMLAC as financial investigator, ilan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Marami po. There are notable cases.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Approximately ilan? 20, 50, 60? For that 36,

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: almost 36 months, almost close to, lahat-lahat po ah. Around almost 80 to 90 cases. Kasi I would assume for each month, marami po nire-refer sa aming kaso.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Is that so? So kayo bang elite investigator o cosigner lang kayo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ano po, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Co-signer lang kayo doon sa dokumento na isasumite sa Sandigan Bayan. Co-signer. Kasi alim ka doon, di ba? Magpipirma doon sa report.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Marami po kami nagpipirma. So we also sign.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Marami ka pipirma.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So ang tawag sa iyo, co-signer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: If that's the definition you're...

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Well, yan ang definition ng AMLAC. Sa katulad sa iyo, na hindi ikaw ang lead investigator, you were just part, kumbaga pro forma lang. Kailangan ka mag-sign dahil kasama ka sa team. So hindi ka talaga ang pinaka-main investigator, hindi talaga nag-initiate sa'yo yung pagbuo ng kaso.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Meron po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga, mga kasama mo. Kasi otherwise, ikaw yung pinaka-main. Ikaw ay kasama lamang doon as co-signer. Hindi ako co-signer po pala.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi po. Ako po yung main investigator. May mga kaso po na main investigator or kapag kukompleks ang kaso, Team ho kayo. Para if not available yung isa, mayroon ho magte-testify na isa pa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya nga. But in some cases, lumilitaw na co-signer ka. Hindi ka talaga... Kung meron man yung sinasabi mo na ikaw ay lead investigator, ilan yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi ko na ho mag... Hindi ho ako nag-inventory... And

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: mapapanindigan mo yun kung magbibigna certification ng AMLAC na kinokontra po yung sinasabi mo ngayon? Kung re-request ng impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. And then two points na lang. Kasi sabi mo, inamin mo na first time mo lang makita yung report na pinakita sa screen na sinumite ni Attorney Cabrera, yung isang expert ng prosecution, forensic. Now first time mo lang makita, and yet, kinukontra mo, nire-refute mo yung nasa report without even studied it first, without having it reviewed. And then agad-agad nakakapagbigay ka na agad ng expert opinion mo. Okay, sige. Thank you po. Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly wrap it up. Senator Judge Raffy, witness will please answer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yeah, so, di ba? Nag-guess mo yung point ko?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So, yun po, no? Kahit ho maigsi ang aking naging stint, sa isang tingin ko pa lang po kanina, alam ko na po kung ano yung mga problema.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Wow! So sa isang tingin mo pa lang, parang kang supercomputer. Nakikita mo agad, parang kang ChatGPT. Isang kita lang, alam mo na agad kung saan ang mali doon. Without even studying it, without even reading it, without even analyzing it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi ho, I'm not saying na mali yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi, kasabi mo sa isang kita lang.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yung mga problema. Sa kanyang report.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So how can you tell that there's a problem with the report? In fact, you haven't even looked at it for 10 minutes at least. Dito pinakita lang sa'yo, parang seconds lang eh. And then agad-agad, you were able to form an opinion and judgment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Binangga ko na kasi ito, your honor, sa aming normal financial investigation process.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Exactly, but still, you have to have at least reviewed the report for let's say 10 minutes, 15 minutes siguro, enough na. Pero kanina, seconds lang ata, wala pang isang minuto. Agad-agad, nakapagbigay ka ng opinion mo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: At saka yung po aking opinion kanina ay binangga ko kung ano yung meron sa batas.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: That is correct. Pero still, for you to be an intelligent witness, expert witness that is, you have to study, analyze, do some research doon sa ipinipresenta sa iyo na dokumento na work. Wherein you were asked to give your expert opinion. So how can you give a proper expert opinion to a certain degree in a certain report or document of you not having full knowledge of it by way of having at least reviewed it, having at least analyzed it? Yan lang sa akin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor. I agree po that if you will be doing a full-blown analysis, it takes time.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: It takes time.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kanina ho kasi guided.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi lang segundo, tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Opo, guided ho kasi kanina yung naging analysis, tinuro ho sa akin yung mga items. So guided din ho yung aking, I'm not discounting the entire report, just the portion shown to me.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Right. Yung sa portion na yun, like you said, isang tingin mo lang agad-agad, alam mo na kung saan, kung ano yung mali doon. Because of your being an expert Bank Officer Two sa AMLC.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I'm not saying that I'm an expert, your honor. I'm again applying as an AML practitioner, my experience.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kasi sir, nirefute mo, binabangga mo ang isang expert witness na si Atty. Cabrera na katulad mo, or I'm sorry, hindi naman kita masyado kilala, na napakalawak yung credentials din. At ikaw sabi mo na respeto mo si Attorney Cabrera, na isang tao na ginagalang mo yung kanyang credentials, kilala mo. Eh, siyempre, hindi mo basta-basta i-refute yung mga binigay niyang report unless kung talagang sure ka na pag-aralan mo siya, na pag-aralan mo yung mga report na binigay niya, at gumawa ka ng malalim na saliksik at research, then only then makapagbigay ka ng expert opinion, siguro, I suppose.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: If I may explain, Your Honor, kanina ko kasi, nung pinakita yung mga sa ating PowerPoint presentation, hypothetical po yung mga questions. Again, I mentioned I have no personal knowledge about the report. I cannot give a definite analysis or conclusion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: You cannot give indefinite analysis.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: As to his methodology, as to paano po yun. So ang tinanong mo sa akin kanina, hypothetical. So I answered also on hypothetical trials. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: hypothetical yung binigay mo answer because the question was hypothetical.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So hindi ka talaga very much aware or well knowledgeable doon sa report at hand na pinakita.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kung ano lang po yung napakita, yun lang po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kung ano lang pinakita, agad-agad nagbigay ka ng iyong opinion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: And there is a high... As much as possible, again, I haven't read the full text. I avoid making conclusions contradicting whatever he did. So kung ano po yung nandoon at ginawang hypothetical yun, again, without discounting other documents, yun lang po ang limitado.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly wind up, Senator Judge Raffy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Maraming salamat po sa iyong pasensya, Mr. Witness. Thank you. Thank you po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Raffy. Senator Judge Kiko is recognized. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Magandang hapon, Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Good afternoon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Kanina nabanggit mo na wala kang political affiliation. Tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: None, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: In fact, sabi mo the last time hindi ka bumoto nga since 2019. Tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi po. Mga sirkomstansya po hindi ako pinayagang makaboto.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero si Atty. Edward Gialogo is your law firm partner.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: When I left the service, 2018 up to 2021.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, he was your law firm partner?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, you are aware? So, ngayon hindi na?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Starting 2021 po. When I started the consulting firm, hindi na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. So, are you aware na si Atty. Gialogo, a lawyer for the Duterte Youth Party List?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, I have no personal knowledge but could be. Because ang naging practice ho niya, election practice, after ho naming mag-part ways, medyo hindi ho kami nag-uusap for years. Ngayon lang ho kami nag-uusap.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So hindi mo alam?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi ko po alam kung ano man yung...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Na naging counsel siya ng Duterte Youth.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Opo. Possible po kasi ang practice talaga niya is election.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero hindi mo nga alam. Possible lang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: May information from legal circles. How long have you known Atty. Gialogo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kami po ay magkaibigan from law school days pa sa San Beda College.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: May information from legal circles and pati na rin sa Facebook na si Atty. Gialogo supported the campaign of the previous president. Are you aware?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, after 2021, Your Honor, wala na kaming communication.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, pero we're talking about 2016. 2016. Sabi niyo matagal na kayong magkakilala. So hindi mo alam kung sinuportahan niya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, your honor. It's his personal matters na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Curious. Sabi mo 2019 hindi ka bumoto. Since 2019. Sino binoto mo noong 2016 sa presidential election?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: mean, you're under oath.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Nakaboto pa ba ako noon?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Presidential election.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I'm just recalling your honor if I voted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. So you cannot recall?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Long time ago.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: It's okay. Kung hindi mo alam, hindi mo alam. Okay. I'll go to another point.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Sabi niyo na kanina nung tinatanong ka sa direct examination, sabi mo, mahirap. Pero kaya gumawa ng forensic report sa loob ng two weeks. You said that, no?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay, so two weeks na pag-aaral o pagbabuo ng forensic report, mahirap pero kaya. Pero dalawang linggo, tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Pero kanina rin sinabi mo, nakita mo ka agad, alam mo na.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, parang... Mahirap gumawa ng forensic report, pero pagka nakita mo yung portion ng forensic report, agad-agad alam mo na. Tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kanina po, may mga tanong lang na hypothetical. It's not about the full report po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes. And therefore, pag hypothetical, kaya mong sagutin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kasi po, themed lang. Limited ang scope.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So what is the probative value of your testimony if you answer hypothetically? In an impeachment trial wherein we look at the evidence and we determine the law necessary or applicable based on the evidence. What is the probative value of your testimony?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I was called upon, Your Honor, to testify on AML standards, how financial investigation is usually conducted. So dun lang po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. You also said in your commentary kanina na... You are able to provide legal opinion or you can analyze whether or not an act is within the bounds of the law. Tama? Sabi mo kanina?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, I just rely po on the law.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: But how will you know if it is within the bounds of the law if you don't know the facts?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, the question, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, the question propounded ay limited lang po doon sa mga hypothetical questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: I hope you understand, ikaw eh nag law school, pareho tayo nag law school, sanay tayo sa recitation, hindi ba? Di ba pag nagre-recite tayo, kailangan we apply the law based on the facts, hindi ba? Pag sinabi ng ating professor, tinawag tayo sa recitation at sinabi sa atin, what is the law, recite the case of people versus etc. Pwede mo bang sabihin dun sa professor? Professor, hindi ko po nabasa yung case, yung decision, pero I can give my comments. Pagdaganon, anong grade mo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Bagsak po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Well, again, in fairness to the witness, he's admitted that his manifestations are all hypothetical. And therefore, we should be guided accordingly. No other questions?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Senator Judge Erwin Tulfo is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ah, palit talaga. Senator Riza is recognized then.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, ma'am. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. At magandang hapon muli, Atty. Dela Fuente. Good

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: afternoon, ma'am. Good afternoon, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Napanggit niyo po kanina na consultant kayo ng CESA.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Nakatawag pansin yun po sa akin dahil marami po nagsasabi na... Doon sa CESA, unang ipinanganak ang POGO.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Tapos trainer din po kayo sa PAGCOR para sa casino sector.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Regulatory compliance po ang expertise nyo. So tama po ba na ibig sabihin tinuturuan nyo po yung mga kumpanya ang mga dapat nilang gawin para makaiwas sa investigasyon at makaiwas din sa liability. Tama po ba yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi. Mag-cooperate with the investigation. At yun po ang natin. These are law-abiding entities. We only deal with registered covered persons po. Kasi sila na din po ang mga ngailangan ng ganitong suporta. So, again, hindi para makaligtas sa investigation. Mag-comply if there is an investigation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Be aware of their AML obligations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Sige po, pag-usapan natin ng konti pa itong mga registered covered persons, itong mga law-abiding entities. At any point po ba, nagkaroon po ba kayo ng kliyente na gambling firms? o POGO. Hindi nyo po kailangan banggitin kung sino po ah, kung nagkaroon. Para lang mas malinawan po tayo in relation sa inyong work experience. Nagkaroon po ba ng POGO or online gambling firms na mga kliyente? Sa

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: PAGCORP po, yes po. Yung mga covered persons po nila because may AML requirements po sila. So, training kasama po yun at saka paggawa po ng mga manuals, risk assessment.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay. So sa PAGCOR, nagkaroon po kayo ng POGO na kliyente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: During those times, yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And nagkaroon din ba kayo sa PAGCOR ng gambling firms na kliyente? Online gambling firms na kliyente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: If they are covered by AMS, yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Sabi niyo rin po kanina, ang AMLAC lamang ang pwedeng mag-imbestiga ng money laundering. Pero tama po ba na sa ngayon, hindi na po kayo parte ng AMLAC?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And then, so, ibig sabihin, hindi nyo na po masasabi ngayon kung nagkaroon o hindi nagkaroon ng mga krimen sa kasong pinag-uusapan dito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor. I am in the private sector.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes, nasa private sector na po kayo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alam nyo po ba kung meron na pong naibigay na lehitimong paliwanag ang Cale88 dun sa mga covered transaction reports at suspicious transaction reports na ipinadala sa AMLOC. Would you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Know, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Pero, sige, medyo may pagka-hypothetical din. Pero, kumpara sa ibang kumpanya na medyo parehong size ng Cale88. Masasabi niyo po bang unusual itong total of wrapping up Mr. Presiding Officer? Masasabi niyo po bang unusual itong total of 757 CTRs at STRs na may halagang 1,254,736,297 pesos and 8 centavos?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kung ito po ay suspicious or unusual?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kung unusual po ba yung ganyang karaming 757 na CTRs? CTRs at STRs total. Sa kasing laking kumpanya tulad ng Cale88.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, ang makakapag-determine po niya ay ang AML sila kung ito ay suspicious. Again, pag sinabi ko kasing suspicious, it doesn't mean that directly merong unlawful activity agad. This is still subject to further checking or further validation. It invites scrutiny.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Pero kumpara dun sa... Walumpu o siyam na pong kasong hinawakan nyo dati nung panahon nyo sa AMLOC. I'm sure meron din kasing laki na kumpanya tulad sa Cale88. Usual po ba na more than 700 plus yung CTRs at STRs? Or usually mas kaunti sa kasing laking kumpanya tulad ng Cale88?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Nakakita na po ako na mas marami pa. Kumpanyang mas marami pa,

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: 'Di hamak, ang kanilang combined

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: CTRs and STRs.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay. Mga ilan dun sa 80 or 90 cases yung may mas marami pa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Libo po. Libo po yung iba.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ah, hindi po. Dun sa 80 or 90 cases na hinawakan nyo nung panahon nyo sa AMLOC?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ah, hindi ko na malaman.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ilan sa kanila may mas marami sa 700 plus CTRs at STRs?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Pag mga corporations po kasi normally ganyan. Kasi... Very malikot ho ang kanilang financial transactions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Lahat nung 80 at 90 na yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Hindi po. Not 100%.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Or mga 8 or 9 nila? Or ilan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Safe po siguro. We can say 30% of that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: 30%. So, ibig sabihin, ang Cale88 ay nagkaroon ng mas maraming CTRs at STRs total ng mga 70%. At least dun sa mga kasong hinawakan nyo nung panahon nyo sa anglap.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Baligtad po. May mas mga korporasyon pa pong mas marami doon sa nabanggit na numero.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So 30% ay mas konti ang number?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Libo po. Iyon sinabi ko, libo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Ilan po ang may mas marami sa 700 plus? 30% o 70%?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Sa akin pong mga nahawakan, umabot hanggang libo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Mga 30% po siguro.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kaya nga po. So 30% ang mas marami na CTRs at STRs.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Opo, ang benchmark po natin si yung company po na yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So mas maraming CTRs at STRs ang Cale88 sa 70% na hinawakan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kasi kung pag korporasyon po, napakadami po talagang in and out transactions. That's normal.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And lastly po, sa official records din ng Cale88, taon-taon itong diumanong lugi, dalawa lang diumanong empleyado.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At 208 million pesos lamang di umano ang idineklarang benta. Pero ayon sa AMLAC, halos 776 million pesos ang flagged as covered or suspicious sa nagpumasok na pera at 319 million pesos dyan galing sa China. So sa mga bank account nitong ipinakita sa Korte, Wala pang 400,000 pesos ang natitira sa katapusan ng bawat taon. Lastly po, Atty. Dela Fuente, hindi po ba yan posibleng mga red flags?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, these are red flags po that merit maimbestigahan po, scrutiny review. But again, red flags po are not direct evidence of wrongdoing.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Marami salamat, Atty. Dela Fuente. Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you. For the third time, Sen. Judge Erwin Tulfo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Ginoong Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Mr. Witness, kanina po natanong kayo tungkol sa Constitution natin at ang inyong mga pananawhingil dito. Ano po? At sinagot nyo naman.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Tutal, natanong po kayo dyan, ano po ang interpretasyon ninyo sa Article 7, Section 13 ng Constitution?

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Ito po yung Pangulo at Vice Presidente, hindi paaring kumuha ng ibang trabaho o mag-aari ng mga negosyo. Ano po ang interpretation niyo po dyan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, we apply verbal legis, the plain meaning of the law, Your Honor. Kung ano po ang nakasulat doon, kung may pagbabawal, yun po. But again, it's up to the impeachment court. Leave it to the wisdom of the impeachment court, how they will interpret.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: No, I'm asking you as a lawyer, sir, and as an accountant, how do you interpret this?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, we apply po verbally the plain meaning of the law.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So, hindi pwede po silang dalawa at kanilang mga cabinet secretaries and assistants na mag-ari ng negosyo. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yan po ay aking humble personal opinion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: That's your personal opinion. Very good. So, sa SEC po, hindi inamin ni VP Sara Ang negosyo niya, ito pong Cale88, o part owner siya. Sa SAL-N niya, nilagay niya po ito. So, anong dokumento po ang paniniwalaan natin kayo ho bilang investigador? Hindi mo ba tinicheck niyo rin ang SEC at saka SAL-N ng isang government official?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor. If there's an ongoing investigation, lahat ho yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. I-check SEC, SALN. Kung magkaiba po, sino ang paniniwalaan niyo? Meron dito, sabi sa SEC, hindi siya bahagi ng kumpanya na yan. Pero sa SALEN po sabi niya, hindi, meron akong hold dyan sa company na yan. Sino ang paniniwalaan mo bilang investigador?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Bilang investigador, dapat neutral muna ang iyong pananaw. Ihintayin mo kung saan ka dadalhin ng ebidensya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: you don't take sides. Para walang prejudice, walang bias. So you gather as much evidence as possible. Kaya sa ating AMLA may compulsive process. Bank inquiry. You interview the witnesses. You do on-sites. And then you prepare your report. So magtitilt ho ang report whether for or against the accused kung ano ho ang mas mabigat na ebidensya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay, panghuling katanungan na lamang ginaong witness. Doon po sa nabanggit ho ninyo, sa inyong pananaw, Yung interpretation po ninyo sa Article 7, Section 13, bawal po ang mga matataas na opisyal natin, ang Pangulo, Vice Presidente, Cabinet Secretaries, etc., na mag-ari o maging bahagi ng isang negosyo. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. So, hingin ko lang po ang inyong pananaw din at this point. Totale, natanong mo kayo ilang beses kanina at magaling po kayo sumagot. Sa tingin mo ba may nalabag na sa konstitusyon ang Vice Presidente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ito, Your Honor, is a question of law. Again, I leave it to the wisdom of the Honorable Impeachment Court to decide if meron o wala.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Maraming salamat po ginoong testigo. Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Erwin. Senator Judge Joel Villanueva is recognized. You may proceed, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, sir, Presiding Officer. Thank you, Mr. President. Just a few questions to Attorney Rainer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Chair din po ako ng Committee on Banks dito sa Senado and we look at how MLC uses financial records to understand the purpose of a transaction. From your experience po as an AMLC investigator, when bank records show that a company paid an individual, what can you verify from the check and the bank entries and what other records would you examine to determine why the company made the payment?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Number one po, ang question, is it out of the profile ng company that would merit scrutiny? Misan po kasi it is explainable, there is a contractual obligation, etc.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Halimbawa po, para mas klaro, halimbawa po a company says it was returning an earlier investment, how would you verify the original contribution, the amount still owed, and whether the payment was actually applied against that balance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, number one, you check po yung kanilang SEC records. You request for certified copies ng kanilang GIS to determine the holdings. So, i-compile niyo po yan. SEC records, if there is a private contract between the company and that individual, you compile them if there is legal basis for that returned money.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Pag-return po ng money, pwede po ba niyo i-differentiate sa akin return on capital versus return of capital?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Return of capital, binabalik ang puhunan. Ito ay hindi considered income. Return on capital, ito ay tubo, kita.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ngayon kung ang return of capital na sinasabi niyo binalik yung puhunan, let's say 48,000 lang ang puhunan, pero ang binalik ay 2,142,000, masasabi niyo na po ba ito ngayon na return on capital?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, this is, again, limited, this is hypothetical based on that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: I'm trying to find out.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: 48 po ang capital pero ang binalik ay more than 2 .1 million.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ang tanong po ay is it a return of?

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: That's why I'm asking the difference between return of capital and return on capital because you mentioned a while ago if it is return of capital. Return of capital, it only means binabalik yung puhunan. Pero ang puhunan ay 48,000 lang. So, di ba naging return on capital na po ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: So, ang tanong po, this can be explained. Possibly po itong nag-accrue na dividendo, hindi niya kiniklaim ang kanyang dividendo. Again, we are...

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ang claim po kasi walang dividendo na nilabas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: So, it merits scrutiny po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yung aking nabigay na teorya ay isa lamang but again we have to test this.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you. And just to be more, to be clarified on this, if payments continue after the recorded capital balance has been fully paid or fully repaid, what records would you look for to determine the basis for the later payments if it is return of capital?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Now, based on that hypothetical scenario, Your Honor, I will check if this is a sort of compensation. Compensation po. Baka sweldo po ito. Hindi na in the capacity of a shareholder but capacity of an employee or officer. Isa po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: And it becomes an income?

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yeah. Thank you for that. Attorney, gusto kong tanungin itong... So

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: suppose a company explains that credits to its bank accounts came from... It's regular export business. From an investigator standpoint, paano po ninyo biniverify yun? And what would you compare in the bank records and the company's records, company's books, para po ma-establish who made the payment, which sale or shipment it covered, and whether the company had already recorded the sale before the money came in?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Number one, sir, yung invoices. Suppliers' invoices, contractual agreements, bill of lading, warehouse receipts. So that would verify if there's really an economic transaction that transpired. So ito kasi ay dokumentong pang-komersyo. So ito ay dokumentado.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: At kung yung kumpanya po nag-presenta ng BOI or FDA registrations and evidence of participation in trade fairs, What further records would you look for to connect a particular remittance to an actual sale? Kasi nga po diba sabi ng Section 3 B.1.1 concerns the purpose of or economic justification of the particular transaction. I'm sure you are very much aware of that.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So normally yung kontrata po behind the transaction should be intact.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: At para humalaman kung bayad po talaga, for example, sa export sale, aling shipment at aling invoice ang tinutukoy.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: It can be verified. Lalo na kung ito ay may export or import, meron hong record yan ng ating gobyerno for the goods that really went in and out.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Sige po. Salamat, Mr. Witness. I'll just do the round two, Mr. President. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Senate President is recognized. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready. Thank you,

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer. Good afternoon, Atty. De La Fuente.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Good afternoon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dahil kayo ay expert witness sa AMLOC, I'll focus on AMLOC.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Tinitignan ko itong report ng AMLOC na sinamit dito sa impeachment. At between 2009, ito yung mga transactions ni VP Sara. So nagsubmit sila sa amin per year yung volume at yung value ng transactions from 2007 all the way to 2025. So nakita ko dito from 2009 to 2013, 2.7 billion pesos ang naging transaction out of the 3.9 billion pesos.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Just a few years. 2009, 700 million. 2010, 648 million. 2011, 597 million. Ngayon, pinasubmit rin sa amin yung taxable income or net taxable income net of tax ng BIR. At lumalabas sa 2009, 600,000. 2010, 700,000. 2011.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: 1 million. So malayong malayo. Malayong malayo. So ganitong mga data na sinabit sa amin, hindi ko inimbento ito, sinabit ito sa amin. Ano ang analysis nyo dito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, yan po ay, it would merit further investigation, Your Honor. Iyan po mag-trigger ng other compulsory processes like freeze order, bank inquiry. So that we can dig into the details. Makita sa statement of accounts the actual deposit slips, withdrawal slips. Yung conclusion natin ay magkakaroon tayo ng conclusion if we get those documents. We gather those documents. As much as possible, no conclusion is being made. We only make the conclusions after exhausting all the legal remedies.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So in other words, based on your experience, kailangan ito further investigation and application of a freeze order kaagad?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yan po sa normal case and bank inquiry.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay. And base sa sinabi nyo, ito bang mga ganito ay tingin nyo highly unusual, malaking red flag? Ano ang personal assessment nyo dito sa ganitong data?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Again, sinubmit ito sa amin. Hindi ko inimbento ito. So based on your analysis, how can you describe these differences?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ang nagde-determine, Your Honor, kung yan ay suspicious or irregular ay yung mga covered persons po natin. Ibabato nila yan sa AMLC for further checking. Si AMLC naman, sila po kasi nakakakita. They can scan. Other STRs, CTRs submitted by other covered persons. So sila ho yung magdidikit-dikit, bubuuin ho nila yung puzzle and check if they can make a picture out of it. Doon naman ho malalaman kung meron talagang, it merits further investigation or kung wala naman, move on to other cases.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ano pa bang kailangan dokumentong hingin? Dahil meron ng, from the BIR, net, income net of tax. What else ang kailangan pa? Dahil may income side ka na, andun na lahat yun. Compensation income, business income. So ano pa bang information ang kailangan para for the investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I think, Your Honor, the bank records. The source documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Dun yung malalaman, sino ang pinuntahan, kaninong nagpunta ang pera, ano ang transaction codes. Kasi ang CTRs and STRs, these are just snapshots. Hindi nyo nakikita talaga yung in-between na mga nangyayari. So makikita nyo yan, if you dig deeper, makita nyo yan sa bank inquiry. Doon nyo makikita ngayon ang buong picture. Mabubuo na ang kwento.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Base rin sa mga bank information, meron rin mga amounts outside of SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ang aking focus dito kasi yung source which is yung income. Diyan naman manggagaling yung source. So base, again, nababalik ako dito, my last question is, base dito sa mga information na binigay sa amin ng AMLAC and BIR, do you think itong discrepancy is an impeachable offense?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: That, Your Honor, is a question of law and I would defer again to the Honorable Impeachment Court if it is or if it is not an impeachable offense.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Marcos is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Yes, maraming salamat, presiding judge. Pagod na yung witness natin, konting tanong na lang. Okay, so unang-una, what is the evidentiary value of AMLOC reports? Ano ba yung timbang nito? Ano ba yung bigat nito? Yung financial intelligence report tungkol kay VP Sara, talagang ginagamit natin, sabi mo kanina, analytical ang ginamit, analytical judgment. At bahagi pa lamang ito ng case build-up at fact-finding. So hindi pa ito yung kompleto. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Under our law, yung susunod hung steps to, yung section 10, 11, and 12, please order bank inquiry. Yun ho yung mas mabusisi na talaga. Evidence gathering and there is a compulsory process. Kaya ho dadaan ito sa Korte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Sorry. Kapag financial intel report pa lamang, hindi pa ito ebidensya, kumbaga? Hindi pa napreba ito? Wala pa siyang bigat, kumbaga?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: May bigat na po ito but hindi pa siya yung ebidensya. Ito ay clues pa lang. Ituturo ho tayo sa ebidensya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Tama. Kasi may direksyon na siyang sinasabi. It expressly advises the recipients to verify information and states that its analytical judgment may be based on only incomplete or fragmentary information. At bilang abogado, would you agree na yung mga media, news articles, mga report na lumalabas sa dyaryo ay hearsay lamang?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: It's second-hand information, Your Honor. Kaya dapat maingat din sila sa paglalabas ng information.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Maingat yung amla, o yung nagbabasa, o yung dyaryo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yung dyaryo po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Tama. Maraming palsipikadong report ngayon. Uso yun. Isa pa, napansin ko at nabanggit kanina yung tungkol sa dalawang insurance company na STR na flinag ng AMLA bilang suspicious transaction. Yung isa, July 2019. Yung isa naman, November 2019. Ngayon, ang dahilan na binibigay na flinag ito bilang suspicious ay dahil lumabas daw sa media na naman na ang mga individual at korporasyon may kinalaman sa flood control investigation sa DPWH. Kaya nagkaroon ng suspicious transaction report. Ngayon, pinagtatakahan ko, 2019 to, kailan ba yung flood control issue? Meron na bang flood control noon? Sa pagkaalam mo, wala pa yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Ang pagkaalam

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: ko, hindi ba lumabas lang yan sa zona noong nakaraang taon? So bago-bago pa lang siya. At isa pa, ang tinatanong ko, kung sakasakali lumitaw yung issue ng flood control ng 2025, alimbawa, tapos 2019 ang tinutukoy, meron bang retroactive flagging? May ganun ba? Legal nung panahon na nangyari, baka tapos five years down the line, pinagbawal na. Pwede pong sabihin na suspicious yung nangyari five years ago?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Posible, Your Honor. During that time, kasi clueless pa ang ating mga bangko. Wala pa silang kaalaman. From the time they learn of this information, they can backtrack. They can check the records.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: So, it can keep going back? Hanggang 10 years, 15 years, 20 years? Pwede bang ganon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Normally po ang retention, well, yes, yes, Your Honor. Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: So, mayroon retroactive flagging. So, pwede ganon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes po. At dahil ito po ay red flags lang, this is subject to further checking, further scrutiny.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: E paano kung bibili ka ng insurance ngayon na hindi naman na illegal, lihiti mo, pagkatapos five years down the line, sasabihin na bawal na to, hindi ba unfair na sabihin bigla na suspicious transaction yung ginawa mo? Na legal naman sa pagkaalam mo at sa pagkaalam ng lahat, at nasa batas naman at sa regulasyon na wala namang pinagbabawal, biglang magiging illegitimate.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Okay lang po yun. Hindi ho siya magmimerit ng agad freezing. Again, suspicious from the word itself. Hindi ho siya criminal transaction report. So, it will only activate checking, verification. Pag sinek at muka naman na... At na-verify, okay na po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Okay na yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kahit retroactive. Yes po, hindi na ho siya magpo-proceed sa ibang mga proseso. Freeze order, bank inquiry for future.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Isang huling tanong na lang. May in-identify na 4.4 billion labas-pasok sa iba't ibang mga account. Yung aggregate amount, yung suma total nun lahat, pwede bang sabihin na income or accumulated wealth ng tao na may-ari nung account? Yung labas-pasok kahit repeated rollover ng iba't-ibang amount, tapos ito-total mo, yun na ba talaga yung pag-aari at kayamanan nilang buo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Malalaman po ito, Your Honor, sa full financial investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: Kung nagkaroon ng double counting or at saka yung inflow at outflow.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Doon na po malalaman yan sa full financial investigation. Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: hindi mo pwedeng isumatotal lamang yung lahat ng pumasok, lahat ng lumabas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Correct your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Sen. Imee Marcos
turns.text: those are all my questions. Maraming salamat, attorney.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Jaime. Senator Judge Villanueva is recognized. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Sir Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Attorney, Mr. Witness, kanina po binanggit natin kung walang dividends hindi pasok doon sa kumpanya na nagbibigay ng nabanggit niyo po kanina, maaari itong compensation. Pero anong masasabi niyo? Kasi kung compensation, wala nga pong empleyado actually. In fact, 23 and 24, dalawa po yung employees. Anong masasabi niyo dito? Pwede pa rin bang compensation yun o hindi na pwedeng tawaging compensation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again, ito po ay theoretical lang po, no? Based on that hypothetical.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Hindi po. Lahat po nung tinanong ko sa inyo, nangyari po yun. At in fact, binanggit nyo nga po na ito'y papasok na dun sa income. Gusto ko lang malaman dun sa binanggit nyo na ba ari itong compensation. Eh kung compensation, eh wala naman po empleyado. Pwede ho bang gamitin yun as compensation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Pwede ho ang may-ari mismo ang nag-aakas empleyado.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ah kung may-ari po siya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Kung may-ari. Opo. Kasi sila ang nag-work.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Lalo na kung yan po ay bagong kumpanya lang. Attorney, base po dun sa dokumentong na isumiti dito sa Korte, nakatanggap po kasi itong... Kale88 ng malalaking halaga ng salapi mula po sa iba't ibang bansa. Kabilang na China, Russia, Ukraine. At sa ilalim po ng Anti-Money Laundering Act at BSP Regulations, ano po ang mga obligasyon ng bangko para tiyakin na legitimate ito at ang mga transaksyong ito ay tugma din dun sa aktwal at nakadiklarang negosyo ng kumpanya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Number one, Your Honor, they have to ask, yung mga bangko natin, what's the purpose for those transactions? Number two, if it will originate from a high-risk jurisdiction, they have to report it. Yan po yung mga triggers. What's the legitimate business purpose? Tapos ititingnan nila, iscreen nila, saan ba ang pinanggalingan ng pera that would merit reporting. Yan po ipapasok sa client and transaction monitoring system ng ating mga bangko. Part of their KYC. Know your client and customer due diligence, CDD.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: High risk at purpose. Doon po sa forensic report na sinubmitibo dito sa Korte, may approximately 222.62 million pesos. foreign remittances ang Cale88 mula po 2023 to 2025. Ang gusto po natin kasing malinawan eh kung anong verification ang dapat gawin ng mga bangko para matukoy po na consistent ang remittance sa declared business activities ng isang kumpanya. In fact, yung legal basis and I'm sure you know about this section 9 letter A ng RA 9160. Sabi po doon, it provides that covered persons shall establish and record the true identity of their clients. Ang tanong ko po, if a company claims that these are export payments, is that declaration sufficient or should additional verification be required depending on the risks identified and why?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Again,

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: self-serving

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: po yung verbal declarations. Normally po, it is backed by documents. Kung ganun kalalaki ang pera, Ito po ay dapat may dokumento, may paper trail. So, normally po, kontrata to support the remittance in or out of the bank.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Maraming pong salamat. Last na po, Atty. Dela Puente. Noong din pong hearing natin dito, October 9, nabanggit po na ang Artmen LLC, isa pong kumpanya sa Ukraine na nagpapadala po ng salapi sa KL88. ay naiugnay umano sa isang investigasyon sa ibang bansa tungkol po sa panluloko at money laundering. Sa ilalim po ng mga regulasyon ng AMLC, kapag may ganito pong informasyon, kayo po yung isang eksperto dito tungkol sa isang foreign company na nagpapadala ng salapik, ano po ang karagdagang pagsusuri at karagdagang pagbabantay na dapat gawin ng mga bangko po na tumatanggap ng remittance?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, number one po, private obligation for them is to report it as suspicious.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yun po ang isang immediate obligation ng mga bangko. Number two, ask the client for justifications regarding the transaction. So, depende na po yan sa internal policy ng mga bangko if they will accept the explanation or not. Kasi may mga covered persons po tayo na hindi nila ina-accept, nagkakaroon po ng de-risking, kinuklose nila yung account. Kapag hindi na nila, they can no longer accommodate the risk with that particular client.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: At kahit po wala pang final conviction, can credible information concerning a foreign criminal... Investigation. Justify enhanced due diligence or suspicious transaction reporting.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So, it invites scrutiny.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Para po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Enhanced due diligence, ibig sabihin, mas maraming dokumentong hihingin, more paperwork. They could delay the transaction, subject to verification. Yun po yung ginagawa natin sa EDD. Bago mag-transact, maraming kailangang senior management approval. Ito po yung mga safeguards na meron ang ating mga bangko bago nila payagamot.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: When you talk about safeguards, ang legal basis po nito, yung Section 3, B1, 5, and 6 ng AMLA law that provides the transactions deviating from the client's profile for past transactions or related to unlawful activities may be considered suspicious transactions. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So doon po natatapos ngayon ang obligasyon ng covered person sa STR. Ang bola po naman ngayon ay napapasa na sa AMLAC. para mag-investiga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Okay. Maraming salamat po for that clarification. Thank you, Mr. Vice President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Kiko, finally.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you. Ang gandang hapon ulit, attorney. I just want to go back dun sa legal position mo na you cannot divulge information to this impeachment court because you're not an end user. Is that right?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I cannot access, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, you cannot access. And therefore, because you cannot access, therefore, you cannot divulge. So you are not an end user?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Even as you testify before this impeachment court?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Why is that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: I was not the addressee of the... We were talking about the investigation report, Your Honor, here, no?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: No, we're talking about the AMLA report. Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Your Honor. I'm not the intended end user. It is the honorable impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: And how do we become the end user if not through witnesses like

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: yourself?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Well, it is directly directed po sa ating impeachment court. Witnesses are not part of those.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So how will you prove a case of anti-money laundering or money laundering if you cannot produce witnesses who will divulge information before the Sandigan Bayan? Or in this case the impeachment...

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: AMLC, your honor, is the proper agency to process the information, not any other person.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So you're saying that this impeachment court violated the law? Is that what you're saying?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: No, your honor. What I'm saying is that you can ask assistance from the AMLC in doing the financial investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, but the forensic expert accessed the information. Impeachment Court allowed it. So you're saying that the impeachment court, in your opinion, committed a violation of the anti-money laundering law?

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: No, your honor. The premise you allowed it, then it is already permitted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So if we compel you to review, I mean hypothetically, since you like to review the report, the forensic report, and ask you to come back and testify as to What you know about the forensic report, then that would be legal.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: If it's the order of the impeachment court, that would be legal. But again, under the law, kasi si AMLC lang ang sole agency that should be doing that job.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Well, with respect to unauthorized disclosures, but the AMLC... are allowed to provide, is allowed to provide information on authorized disclosures.

turns.speaker: Atty. Rainer P. Dela Fuente
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.
